title: ひと言を、制作の設計図へ
distinct_from: The 20 s 1280x720 product video planned inside outputs/motion.json was not made. This 32 s explainer is a separate film about the brief-to-demo skill.
persistent_shapes: book: SKILL.md (brief-to-demo), the instruction the AI reads, with 3 rule slips from concept/structure.json rules
tray: 受け取ったもの — the single request paper and an empty dashed 素材 slot (no materials were supplied)
sheet: the same request paper moving tray -> AI desk -> opening into the packet
ai: ONE AI desk (reads and writes; no live run, the briefs are saved production output)
packet: 制作ブリーフ 11項目 — request band plus 10 compartments in explanatory groups 依頼の芯5 / 制作に必要なもの2 / 作り方と完成3
pocket: the 11th compartment 未指定・仮の条件, hatched, with 4 hollow (unset) pins and the saved phrase 日時・会場・定員は未提供 next to an empty 未設定 box
route: 4 category chips from the schema (ui-ux selected; agents dashed, no saved example) and the skill to read, frontend-design
handoff: outputs/ui-handoff.txt, 3,156 B, with its three instructions skill_refs / assumptions / acceptance
next: dashed outline 次の制作・未実行 with an outlined phone icon; never filled, never checked

scenes.title: AIが読む指示書
scenes.sub: brief-to-demo の SKILL.md と、3つの決まり
scenes.conveys: The skill is a Markdown instruction book for an AI to read, not a program or service.
scenes.enter: The book is visible at 0 s and opens (0-1.2 s).
scenes.exit: Three rule slips appear one by one (0.5-2.6 s): 成果物から分野へ / 受け取っていない事実を足さない / 推測した条件は別に.

scenes.title: 指示書と依頼1枚を、1つのAIへ
scenes.sub: 受け取ったのは短い依頼文だけ。素材はなし
scenes.conveys: Only the short request came in; the materials slot is empty. Book and request go into one AI.
scenes.enter: Tray with the request paper and empty 素材 slot (4.0-4.6 s), AI desk (4.4-5.0 s), lines in (5.0-5.8 s).
scenes.exit: The paper moves onto the AI desk (6.3-7.6 s); a dashed ghost 依頼文1枚 stays in the tray.

scenes.title: 同じ紙が、11項目のブリーフに開く
scenes.sub: 4つのまとまりは説明用。11項目は原典のJSON
scenes.conveys: The same paper opens into the 11-key brief; the 4 groups are explanation only.
scenes.enter: Empty dashed packet with all compartment labels (8.0-8.5 s); paper opens into it (8.6-10.0 s).
scenes.exit: Groups fill in order (9.8-12.0 s); the assumptions pocket slides partly out of the packet edge (11.6-12.4 s).

scenes.title: 次に受け取る素材と、読むスキル
scenes.sub: 素材は計画だけ・分野 UI・UX → 読む frontend-design
scenes.conveys: The received request (tray) and the planned, not-yet-received materials (dashed, 未受領) are shown side by side. Category chosen from the deliverable; skill to read named.
scenes.enter: Tray and 次に受け取る素材 glow together (13.2-13.8 s); category chips appear (14.4-15.0 s).
scenes.exit: UI・UX fills and the by-result rule glows (14.8-16.0 s); frontend-design appears (16.0-16.7 s). Nothing is read or run here.

scenes.title: 仮の条件は、別のポケットへ
scenes.sub: 「日時・会場・定員は未提供」。値は入れない
scenes.conveys: Assumptions are separated from the brief body; unsupplied facts stay unset.
scenes.enter: The pocket separates with stitched seams (18.3-19.5 s); 4 hollow pins appear (19.3-20.7 s).
scenes.exit: The saved phrase and an empty 未設定 box appear (20.8-21.6 s). No value, no approval mark.

scenes.title: 保存したJSONと、引き継ぎ文
scenes.sub: ui.json 2,733 B・ui-handoff.txt 3,156 B・次の制作は未実行
scenes.conveys: What comes back is the saved JSON and the copyable handoff text. The next production is a separate task that has not been run.
scenes.enter: Lines to the outputs (23.1-23.8 s); ui.json and ui-handoff.txt appear solid (23.4-24.8 s).
scenes.exit: Dashed 次の制作・未実行 desk with an outlined phone icon (25.4-26.4 s) and dashed connections (26.0-27.1 s). Acceptance squares stay empty.

scenes.title: ひと言を、制作の設計図へ
scenes.sub: 指示書と依頼 → 1つのAI → 11項目 → 保存・コピー
scenes.conveys: Stable full path with 11 fields, 4 assumptions and the usable files.
scenes.enter: All actual edges traced in signal orange and emphasis returns to full (28.3-28.9 s); title and rail switch 28.5-28.9 s.
scenes.exit: Still from 29 s to 32 s; poster at 31 s. The future connections stay dashed and uncolored.

quoted_strings_source: The request, category label, skill name, unset phrase, file names and byte sizes are read at runtime from the validated assets (concept/structure.json, samples.json, inputs/requests.json, outputs/ui.json, outputs/ui-handoff.txt). The unset phrase is checked as an exact substring of the saved assumptions[1].
